Closing verification (sanctioned non-force path), main @9bdb22f5887. Ticked all 5 ACs after re-verifying each:

- AC1 (Jira-origin comment mirrors inbound): the differ now reads the REAL nested Jira-REST shape jira_fields['comment']['comments'] at src/rebar/_engine_support/../rebar_reconciler/inbound_differ.py:309-311 (exact path src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/inbound_differ.py), and the fetcher genuinely populates it — src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/fetcher.py:647-651 merges client.get_comment_map(project_key) into snapshot[key]['comment']. Pinned by test_diff_reads_real_comment_snapshot_shape.
- AC2 (simultaneous convergence, no duplicates/echo re-import): test_compute_inbound_mirrors_jira_origin_comment builds exactly the 1-local + 1-Jira case (local echo already mirrored as jira_comment_id 20002 plus Jira-origin 20001) and asserts exactly one inbound mutation carrying only the Jira-origin comment.
- AC3 (echo / already-mirrored not re-imported): test_diff_real_shape_filters_echo (RECONCILER_MARKER) and test_diff_real_shape_skips_already_mirrored (jira_comment_id set-diff).
- AC4 (with_comments no longer structurally 0): the counter at src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/run_differs.py:601 sums inbound mutations carrying comments; since the differ now reads the key the fetcher actually writes, that count is non-zero whenever Jira-side comments exist — which is precisely what the end-to-end test above demonstrates.
- AC5 (RED->GREEN test): tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_inbound_differ_comment_snapshot_shape.py, whose module docstring names this bug id and the wrong-key root cause.

Verified now: .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/diffing/test_inbound_differ_comment_snapshot_shape.py -q -> 4 passed. Checkbox ticks are attestation-safe (box state is normalized out of the material fingerprint).
